overview.title: Admin console
overview.subtitle: Keep an eye on people, courses and AI calls.

card.usersBody: Search people and change who is a learner, instructor or admin.
card.coursesPending: {count} waiting for review. Approve or send back.
card.coursesClear: Nothing waiting. Browse every course with filters.
card.aiBody: Calls per feature, real vs demo mode, tokens and speed.
card.scenariosBody: Who is playing the long-form practice runs, and who is not.
card.badgesBody: How many learners hold each badge, and which ones nobody reaches.

users.title: Users and roles
users.subtitle: Find someone and change what they can do on Sprout.
users.emptyBody: Try part of a name or an email address.
users.selfNote: That is you. Another admin can change your role.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Review what people want to publish, and browse everything else.
courses.queueEmptyBody: Nothing is waiting for review right now.
courses.archiveConfirm: Take {title} out of the catalog? Learners keep their progress.

review.sendBackConfirm: Send {title} back to its author as a private draft?

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.subtitle: Every AI call is logged with its feature, model, tokens and speed.
aiUsage.configured: An AI key is set. Calls go to the real provider until a user hits the daily limit.
aiUsage.demo: No AI key is set, so every feature answers in demo mode with built-in mock replies.
aiUsage.byFeatureSubtitle: Feature names follow module.action, e.g. tutor.chat
aiUsage.emptyBody: Try the tutor or generate a course, then come back.

chart.caption: Last {days} days: {real} real AI calls and {mock} mock calls.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.subtitle: Read-only: scenario content ships with the code, not the database.
scenarios.untouchedHint: Scenarios with no runs at all.
scenarios.badRequest: That scenario could not be recognised.
scenarios.closed: {name} is closed. Learners see a notice instead.
scenarios.emptyBody: This table fills up as people play.

badges.title: Badges
badges.subtitle: Read-only: a badge is computed from the event log, never stored.
badges.everyoneHint: They no longer tell learners apart.
badges.emptyBody: Badge reach appears once people start using the platform.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Changes admins have made. Newest first.
activity.emptyBody: Role changes, course reviews and closed scenarios show up here.

modules.title: Feature modules
modules.subtitle: What this build ships. Each one is a line in src/registry/modules.ts.

descriptions.onboarding: A short chat with Pip that builds a learner profile and a recommended path.
descriptions.courses: Browse mini-courses, enrol, and learn lesson by lesson.
descriptions.activities: Quiz, sorting game, sequencing, in-browser coding, narrated slides and AI role-play.
descriptions.self-learn: Learners type any topic and get a personal mini-course generated by AI.
descriptions.review: Collects the quiz questions a learner missed and brings them back on a spaced schedule.
descriptions.leaderboard: Weekly and all-time XP rankings, class boards and a transparent course race.
descriptions.ai-tutor: Ask Pip anything, with the current lesson as context.
descriptions.studio: Instructors create, AI-generate, edit and publish mini-courses.
descriptions.classes: Instructors import students, assign courses and track engagement.
descriptions.scenarios: Long-form practice: supervise an AI agent, run a small team for three weeks, or sit a practice interview. Choices carry forward.
descriptions.achievements: Badges derived from the event log, plus the Pip growth journey: XP in, leaves out. Nothing is stored twice.
descriptions.admin: Users and roles, course review queue, AI usage and platform stats.

actions.cannotChangeOwnRole: You cannot change your own role. Ask another admin.
actions.courseNotPending: This course is no longer waiting for review.
actions.approved: {title} is now in the public catalog.
actions.rejected: {title} went back to its author as a draft.
